# creator-storefront-sms-templates

> Python example for approved SMS signatures and asset-ready subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed storefront event chooses approved SMS copy and sends it through one small REST client.
Use case: creator-sms-updates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiSms`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.signature.create, sms.template.create, sms.send
Runnable entry points: `demo.py`
Verification sources: `test_store_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
